name: animated-theme-toggler
title: Theme Toggler
description: A light / dark toggle that reveals the new theme with a View Transition, as a circle, polygon or star growing from the button.

props.name: duration
props.description: Length of the reveal in milliseconds.

props.name: fromCenter
props.description: Grow the reveal from the centre of the viewport instead of from the button.

props.name: theme
props.description: Controlled theme (works with v-model:theme). When set, the component does not write to localStorage.

emits.name: themeChange
emits.description: Fired on every toggle with the new theme (Magic UI's onThemeChange).
